commits.subject: interop-psd: byte-order aware layer readers parse little-endian MIB8/46B8 ImageSourceData
interop-psd: little-endian ImageSourceData tests (twin fixture, hostile inputs, Pillow Photoshop-CS sample)

capabilities_done: Reader has a byte-order mode (with_order): LE numbers, reversed 4-byte tags returned in canonical spelling; no second parser (layers::parse_tagged_blocks/read_record/read_channel_data, document::read_layer_info, resources::read_unicode, compression RLE counts take the order)
image_source_document accepts MIB8 and 46B8 (8-bit only); PsdLayer.little_endian marks such layers so mask/lsct/lyid/luni accessors read LE payloads

typed refusals: image_source_little_endian_depth (depth != 8), image_source_little_endian_adjustment (adjustment/fill blocks), image_source_little_endian_effects (cached-pixel/effect blocks), little_endian_layer_write (write_psd is import-only for LE layers)
V4-01: #![deny(clippy::arithmetic_side_effects)] added to reader, layers, compression, resources, document, pixels and the touched arithmetic made checked/saturating

blockers.error: hsk-studio-harness tests/import_tiff.rs still asserts the old LE refusal and now fails (2 of 4): photoshop_tiff_imports_its_composite_exactly_and_records_the_layers_as_typed_loss (line 109, asserts parse_error contains image_source_little_endian) and photoshop_tiff_imports_its_layers_through_interop_psd (line 314, Pillow sample expectations). Harness is not an owned path of this lane; its crate compiles and clippy is clean with --all-features

next: harness owner updates import_tiff.rs for LE layers (Pillow sample now yields 2 layers Background / Layer 1); then validator

notes.real_photoshop_parity: NOT_PROVEN: layers parsed from the Pillow Photoshop-CS file bytes only; expected names/count/channels/rects/lengths taken from independent byte inspection of the file (2 layers: Background R,G,B; Layer 1 alpha,R,G,B; rect 0,0,374,278)
notes.sha_pin: interop-psd test pins the Pillow file by length 313740 + tag length 188236 (no hash dependency in the crate); sha256 pin stays in the harness test
